On a phone the plant list opens at 60% of the screen instead of half, and its first plants show without scrolling: the title row, Recent and the hints above the list are gone. How many plants match is still said just above them.
The row for planting a bed (For: Anywhere, or one of your beds) shows only once your plan has a bed, at the top of the list beside its ✕.
Swipe the plant list down by its handle to close it, or press anywhere on the plan. Dragging the plan still moves it around with the list open.
Where the hardiness zones come from is a small “Source” beside “Hardy in zone”, which opens the full citation. A plant's long citations open the same way, without pushing its details apart.
In a plant's details, facts that come only from the earlier list, not yet checked against a source, are marked “Unverified”.
A plant's details put a single “In winter” fact on the same line as its label, and “See photos” on a line of its own, with a picture icon.
